 Pete Davidson is channeling The Sopranos for Halloween !
 On Sunday (November 1), the 32-year-old comedian’s ex-girlfriend Elsie Hewitt took to Instagram to share some photos as they reunited to celebrate their 10-month-old daughter Scottie ‘s first Halloween.
 Scottie was dressed as Tony Soprano, wearing a bath robe, gold watch, and holding a fake cigar as her wagon was set up to look like a pool complete with a blue blanket and stuffed ducks. A neon “Bada Bing!” sign was hanging off the side of the wagon in reference to the strip club Tony owned in the hit HBO series.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by elsie (@elsie) 
 Elsie , 30, went as Christopher Moltisanti by wearing a neck brace, sunglasses, and track suit.
 For his part, Pete dyed the sides of his hair gray and wore a black leather jacket and sunglasses to channel Paulie Gualtieri.
 Elsie and Pete welcomed Scottie in December 2025, naming her after Pete ‘s late father , Scott Matthew Davidson . They split five months later and reached a co-parenting agreement in July.
 If you didn’t see, Pete recently sparked dating rumors with this realty star .
